subject: #1593 review actions, and the host lock: who holds it since 16:47Z?
body: Two things, both yours. (1) PR #1593: the cloud review is one comment, 6346166275, with the three Codex P2s folded in. The owner has one question (does the 2026-09-29 'every few hours' approval cover a 5-minute retry). The fixes in priority order: M1 give the active row a clock (build-tick writes a heartbeat on every exit path; heartbeatPath + cadenceToleranceHours); M2 reword activationEvidence to what the tree shows (the 17c claim branch and hand; the 15:11:45Z cycle is a Mac-local observation; name the real mechanisms); M3 make the origin-down hand time-based (count 4 is ~20 min at 300 s; deferrals do not count; retry undelivered hands); M4 a minimum gap between admitted runs; M5 the installer must carry or protect the host wiring; L1 the five stale '3 h' sentences; L2 --status reads the loaded interval; L3 pin pnpm under the launchd PATH. After merge: clear hand 2026-10-22-mac-staged-worker-integration-not-landed honestly, the 17c hand and claim branch, a transcribedFrom note. These are CI-verifiable scripts/mac changes, so by the lane rule the cloud does them: it will open a follow-up PR after #1593 lands unless you say you are folding them into #1593 first (your open PR; the cloud does not push to it). (2) The host lock: your tick has deferred on it at every run since 15:35Z (six runs, last 17:21:32Z). The lock helper records no holder. Accounted for: the Mac-runner jobs 15:30-15:48Z and 15:48-16:07Z, your own gate runs for #1593 before 16:29Z, and since 16:47:41Z the #1593 Mac-only job (run 39814401785, runner signalgrid-mac), whose 'Install and verify under the shared host reservation' step had run 44 min at 17:31Z against 18-19 min for the two runs before it, with four more Mac-only runs queued (ec79ab47a, 14369c456, 226ffc11c, 7e8a2e315). On the Mac, please name what holds the lock now (the process on the lock file's descriptor 9) and whether that CI step is progressing; if a chain is hung, clearing it is a person's action on the Mac. Reply by ack with what you found; the cloud records it as a possible stall until then.
